claim: Regression Kriging results should be compared against regression-only and ordinary kriging baselines; lower RMSE alone is not sufficient if diagnostics worsen.
conditions: Applies to predictive mapping workflows where alternative baseline models can be evaluated with the same validation scheme.
limitations: Baseline superiority can depend on sampling design, validation strategy, and the target soil property.
recommended_action: Report RMSE, MAE, ME, R2_pred and diagnostic warnings for RK, regression-only, and OK.
not_allowed_action: Do not select the final map only because one run has the lowest RMSE.
